title: A/R Detail: an expanded bucket shows 100 lines, then loads more on scroll
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure one aging bucket, bucket A, has more than 150 open lines on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every bucket collapsed.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand bucket A with its own chevron.
  2. Count the lines shown in bucket A before any more load (or compare them with the bucket's first 100 rows in a CSV export).
  3. Scroll further down.
  4. Collapse bucket A with its own chevron.
  5. Click the chevron button in the top-left header cell (Expand all).
  6. Count the lines shown in bucket A before any more load.
  7. Scroll further down.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bucket A opens.

Step 2:

  • It shows its first 100 lines.

Step 3:

  • More lines load as you scroll, continuing the same order with no line repeated.

Step 4:

  • Bucket A closes.

Step 5:

  • Every bucket expands.

Step 6:

  • Bucket A again shows its first 100 lines.

Step 7:

  • More lines load as you scroll.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R4: “On A/R Detail and A/P Detail, expanding a bucket (by hand or with Expand all) shows its first 100 lines, then loads more as the user scrolls. This is as today on A/P Detail and new on A/R Detail, which today shows a whole bucket at once.”
  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”
